parameters.content:
# 1. COLLECT

Runs every morning at 09:00 clinic time.
Reads the whole Appointments sheet, then the Code node
filters to tomorrow, validates consent and contact
details, and pre-renders both message bodies.

# 2. DECIDE & SEND

Patients without consent or with a
malformed phone/email go to the Exceptions sheet instead
of being silently dropped. Everyone else is routed to the
channel they agreed to.

# 3. RECORD & REPORT

The sheet write-back is the
idempotency guard: a row marked YES is never picked up
again, so a re-run cannot double-text a patient.
Slack gets one summary per run, not one per patient.
